parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh\_cn**. Valid values:

- **zh\_cn**: Chinese

- **en\_us**: English

parameters.name: ReportTaskStatus
parameters.description:
The status to set for the report task. Valid values:

- **0**: Disable

- **1**: Enable

><notice>

This parameter is required.

></notice>
